The X500 Series from Testometric is a bench-mounted, twin-column Universal Testing Machine equipped with a precision AC servo drive system and complete computer control. The X500 Series comes with a high rigidity load frame with an accurate crosshead guidance system for even the most challenging test applications of up to 100 kN.

Made to Measure
With high-precision control and accuracy, the complete digital testing system allows automated computer control of test methods for easy operation.
High-resolution load cells with precisions better than +/− 0.5% and down to 1/1000th of the load cell capacity
Software calibration check facility for immediate verification of machine precision
Extensometers and load cells are automatically recognized with on-device storage of calibration parameters
Overload capability of load cells is 800% without causing any damage
Crosshead guidance system offers smooth running and accurate alignment
Pre-loaded, high-efficiency, self-cleaning ballscrews allow rapid and quiet testing; equipped with sealed-for-life lubricated end bearings
Integral load cell cable routing in machine column prevents snagging and damage to void cables
Precision crosshead control through a brushless servo motor and a digital AC servo drive offers 23-bit positional control and a maintenance-free operation
High-speed data collection systems for up to four synchronous channels
Six I/O channels for extra devices, like micrometers, extensometers, balances, calipers, etc.
Overtravel, overload and impact protection provided
Rigid extruded support columns with T-slots and high-stiffness loading frames and precision ground steel guide rods are available for accessory mounting
A broad range of fixtures and grips for compression, tension, shear, flexural, peel, product testing, etc.
An extensive range of contacting and non-contacting extensometers, such as laser and video models, is available
Telescopic covers provide extra protection for ballscrews from testing debris and dust
Compact footprint design saves floor and bench space.

Built for Precision
Force Measurement
Universally calibrated and better than Grade 0.5 EN 7500-1, DIN 51221 ASTM E-4 and AFNOR A03-501. The minimum range varies from 0.4% to 100%. Load cells are automatically identified and electronically protected. Resolution is 1 part in 500000.
Extension Measurement
Complete frame length to the highest resolution of 0.000001 mm (selectable) and precision is +/− 0.01 mm. Relative, absolute and auxiliary modes in inch, mm and percent are available.
Speed Control
Industry-leading low-speed performance with speeds as low as 0.00001 mm/minute. Drive system temperature and current protection are also available
Load Frame
The rigid frame uses a rigid extruded support column and precision ground steel guide rods. Frame stiffness is up to 400 kN/mm with a built-in K factor facility. Re-circulating ball screw with bellows, customer-programmable safety stops, total travel trips and electronic limit trips are available.
Electronics System
Modular electronics system allows quick data transfer to the PC (up to 1000 Hz) through a high-speed Ethernet connection. Comprehensive input options help link a broad range of accessories and extensometers through easy plug-in interface modules
Safety Features
Broad safety features, such as overload/impact detection, programmable extension limits and E-Stop, guarantee the highest levels of operator safety. Fully conforms to global safety directives, such as 2006/42/EU Machinery Directive, 2014/30/EU Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive and 2014/35/EU Low Voltage Directive.
Optional Touchscreen Panel PC
When the machine is coupled with the optional IPC3 industrial-grade Panel PC with touchscreen control, it becomes a powerful independent system without the need for a Laptop or an external PC.
With the help of the latest Windows 10 operating system and running a complete version of winTest software from Testometric, the system enables full control of the test machine and offers storage and access to infinite test methods and results.
The included mounting arm, which fixes to the machine column T-Slots, can be completely adjusted for reach, height and viewing angle, thus enabling users to determine the most ergonomic working position.

4 GB 1600 MHz SODIMM DDR3 204-pin
Image Credit: Testometric Company Ltd
Tried and Tested Software
All Testometric versions are provided with the company’s extensive winTest Analysis software package.
winTest Analysis is the product of several years of constant growth and offers an intuitive and software package to suit all kinds of material testing. The built-in test methods cover compression, tensile, peel, flexural, tear, shear, creep, cyclic and multi-stage tests.
The winTest Analysis contains a wide range of industry-standard test methods and the facility to make and store a limitless number of additional test methods.
All test data can be automatedly stored and can be easily exported to other software packages, like Excel, Access, Word and SPC systems for improved report generation. Users can refer to the winTest software datasheet for more information.
With the inclusion of the RCE remote connection option, all machines can be directly web-linked to Testometric for remote investigation, tracking and software upgrades. Users can refer to the RCE datasheet for additional information.
